title: Noah Is Saved, and Hud Comes to 'Aad

paragraphs.text: Noah again told his people to fear Allah and obey him. But they said, "Should we believe you, when only the lowest people follow you?" Noah answered that he did not know what those followers used to do. Their account is only with his Lord, if the people could understand. He said he would never drive away the believers. He was only a clear warner. The people threatened him. They said, "If you do not stop, O Noah, you will surely be stoned."

Noah turned to his Lord. He said, "My Lord, my people have denied me. So judge between me and them with a final judgment. Save me and the believers who are with me." Allah answered his prayer. He saved Noah and those with him in the fully loaded ship. Then He drowned all the rest who remained behind. In this there is a sign, but most of them did not believe. Your Lord is the Mighty, the Merciful.

Then the people of 'Aad also denied the messengers. Their brother Hud came to them with the same message. He asked, "Will you not fear Allah?" He told them that he was a trustworthy messenger sent to them. So they should fear Allah and obey him.

hardWords.m: a record of deeds to be judged
